matching_criterion_description: Progressive loss of acquired motor or cognitive milestones is consistently absent. Any neurodegenerative course argues decisively against NAV3.
Comprehensive neuroimaging in molecularly confirmed cohorts does not reveal lissencephaly, pachygyria, or holoprosencephaly.
Infantile spasms and intractable epileptic encephalopathies have not been observed in NAV3 cohorts.
